overview.title: Shopify
overview.description: Sync products, stock and orders between Inventoros and your Shopify stores. Everything runs in the background, so Inventoros never waits on Shopify.
overview.emptyReadOnly: No store is connected yet. Ask someone who can manage Shopify to connect one.
overview.setupHint: Install your Shopify app with the scopes in the setup guide. Connect using app client credentials for stores in your own Shopify organization, or an existing Admin API token.

form.paymentsUpgrade: Update Inventoros core to enable imported-payment records.
form.paymentsHint: Imports completed transactions into the payment ledger. This does not charge or refund customers. Reconcile existing manual payment entries first to prevent duplicates.
form.historyBefore: Import orders before this date as history (optional)
form.historyHint: History does not change current stock or announce new orders. Set the import start date far enough back and run a full sync. Older than 60 days requires approved read_all_orders access.
form.authHint: Client credentials work when the app and store belong to the same Shopify organization. The API secret key is also the app client secret. Tokens renew automatically before expiry.
form.name: Name
form.shopDomainHint: Your store's myshopify.com address, for example my-store.myshopify.com.
form.accessTokenHint: Starts with shpat_. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.webhookSecretHint: Used to verify that webhooks really come from Shopify.
form.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
form.stockInventoros: Inventoros: push Inventoros quantities to Shopify
form.stockShopify: Shopify: apply Shopify quantities to Inventoros
form.productSource: Who owns product names and prices
form.productShopify: Shopify: copy Shopify changes into Inventoros
form.productInventoros: Inventoros: push Inventoros changes to Shopify
form.ordersSince: Import orders placed on or after

connection.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {name}? Its mappings and history are deleted. Orders and stock changes it made in Inventoros are kept.
connection.pausedUntil: Syncing is paused after repeated failures until {time}.
connection.webhooksMissing: Webhooks not registered yet: the scheduled sync still runs every 15 minutes.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: Which Shopify record stands for which Inventoros record. Only confirmed mappings sync; suggestions wait for you.
mappings.primaryHint: Variants and imported orders use the primary location.
mappings.empty: Nothing here. Run a sync from the Stores page to read your Shopify records.

activity.title: Sync activity
activity.description: Every sync, push and webhook, what it changed, and anything that failed.
activity.noFailed: Nothing is waiting for a retry.
